title: Magenta case: Mussolini's RS33 investigation group

tellings.quote:
And the magenta case is so interesting
because Mussolini thought it was a a
Nazi advanced craft or a British or
American advanced craft when he had his
own special investigation group, the
RS33, who was like really keen on the
fact this wasn't human technology and
then likely worked with the Nazis.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show in 2025, tells of a craft said to have crashed in 1933 near Magenta, in northern Italy. He says Benito Mussolini, Italy's dictator, at first thought it was an advanced Nazi, British or American aircraft, but his special investigation group, called RS33, was keen on the idea that it was not human technology and likely later worked with the Nazis. If true, a government would have been studying a non-human craft years before the Second World War.
